Card Payment Convenience Fee
Card Payment Convenience Fee
The University incurs ongoing third party fees for accepting and processing credit card payments, and the fee covers these costs.
The Card Payment Convenience Fee is an additional 1.9% that is applied to payments that you choose to pay using your credit card. When paying online, this fee also applies to debit cards. The Convenience Fee applies to most payments for University-provided goods and services, including fees and accommodation. It does not apply to donations.
